info.title: TT Media Server API (C++ Drogon)
info.description: High-performance C++ implementation of the TT Media Server using Drogon framework. Provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions API for benchmarking server overhead.

tags.name: Completions
tags.description: Raw text and token completion endpoints

tags.name: Images
tags.description: OpenAI-compatible image generation, image-to-image, and edit endpoints. Only the route matching the active runner_type is registered at runtime.

tags.name: Video
tags.description: Text-to-video jobs (Wan2.2). Only registered when MODEL_SERVICE=video. POST returns a job id; poll it, download the mp4, cancel or delete it.

tags.name: Text to speech processing
tags.description: Text-to-speech audio generation endpoints. Only registered when MODEL_SERVICE=tts.

post.description: Available only for meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct; other models return HTTP 404. Prompt and stop token IDs must be below 128256. Non-streaming completions from raw text or token IDs, without a chat template. Batched prompts execute sequentially and retain input order. Supports n=1; use repeated prompts for multiple samples. Behavior logprobs are unavailable and returned as null. Seeds and unsupported generation constraints are rejected.

200.description: Completions in prompt order with aggregate usage

500.description: Generation failed; partial results are not returned

post.description: Creates a chat completion for the provided messages. OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Messages are converted to a prompt internally; responses use object "chat.completion" and choices[].message with role and content.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. missing or empty messages)

post.description: Creates an embedding vector for the provided input text. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Generates speech audio from text. Registered only when MODEL_SERVICE=tts. The initial C++ implementation streams audio/wav.

voice_sample.description: Optional PCM16 WAV voice reference. The server normalizes it to 16 kHz mono PCM16 before scheduling.

post.description: Creates one or more images from a text prompt. Only registered when the active image runner_type is a text-to-image variant.
Generates a new image from a prompt and an input image. Only registered when the active image runner_type is an image-to-image variant.
Edits an input image using a prompt and a mask (inpainting). Only registered when the active image runner_type is an edit/inpaint variant.

400.description: Invalid request (missing prompt, image, or mask)

post.description: Queues a text-to-video generation and answers 202 with the job. Poll GET /v1/videos/generations/{job_id} until the status is `completed`, then fetch the mp4 from the `/download` route. With `async=false` (query parameter or JSON field; the query parameter wins) the request is held open and the mp4 is returned in the response instead, with no job record. The default comes from USE_ASYNC_VIDEO (true). Only registered when MODEL_SERVICE=video.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: false = sync mode: wait and return the mp4. One of true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off.

422.description: Invalid JSON body, invalid field value or invalid `async`

429.description: Too many unfinished jobs (MAX_QUEUE_SIZE) or the queue is full

500.description: Sync mode: generation failed or the file is missing

503.description: The model is still warming up (poll /tt-liveness for model_ready) or the stored job limit (MAX_JOBS) is reached

get.description: Status and metadata of one job. `request_parameters` echoes the parameters, with null for the ones that were not sent.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Public job id (UUID) returned by POST /v1/videos/generations

delete.summary: Delete a finished video job and its mp4
delete.description: Only a finished job (completed, failed or cancelled) can be deleted. Cancel an active job first.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Public job id (UUID) returned by POST /v1/videos/generations

409.description: The job is still queued, running or cancelling

get.description: All job records the server still holds, in task id order.
Streams the mp4 of a completed job. A single `Range` header is honoured (206) so players can seek; other range forms are ignored and the whole file is sent.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Public job id (UUID) returned by POST /v1/videos/generations

404.description: No such job, or its file is not available

409.description: The job is not completed yet (the message names the status, keep polling)

post.description: A queued job becomes `cancelled` at once. A running job becomes `cancelling` and turns `cancelled` when the worker returns, because the device cannot be interrupted mid-generation. 404 also covers a job that is already finished or already cancelling.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Public job id (UUID) returned by POST /v1/videos/generations

get.description: Liveness probe (same as Python tt-liveness). Returns 200 with {"status": "alive", ...system status} when the process can respond. model_ready in the body reflects whether any worker has warmed up. Does not return 503 for model not ready; 500 only on unrecoverable failure.

200.description: Process is alive; body includes status alive and system status (model_ready, workers, queue)

500.description: Unrecoverable failure (e.g. no service configured, exception)

get.description: Returns the current maximum session count. This may be either the value set via the POST endpoint or the default from the MAX_SESSIONS_COUNT environment variable.

post.description: Sets the maximum session count at runtime. This overrides the MAX_SESSIONS_COUNT environment variable. Set to 0 to clear the override and revert to the environment variable value. Changes take effect immediately for new session allocation attempts.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. missing field or invalid value)

get.description: Exposes all server metrics in Prometheus text exposition format (version 0.0.4). No authentication required. Intended to be scraped by a Prometheus server every few seconds.

schema.example:
# HELP tt_generation_tokens_total Total number of generation tokens produced
# TYPE tt_generation_tokens_total counter
tt_generation_tokens_total{model_name="llm"} 42

get.description: Returns the build identity of the running server: tt-inference-server version and commit, tt-llm-engine commit, tt-metal commit, and active model service. Missing values appear as the literal string "unknown". No authentication required.

model.description: Must match the loaded model when supplied.

prompt.description: Raw prompts; no BOS or chat-template tokens are added. Llama-3.2-1B IDs must be below 128256.

return_token_ids.description: Include every sampled token, including EOS and tokens with no displayable text.

top_k.description: Llama-3.2-1B supports at most 32 candidates; -1 uses its default candidate set.

stop_token_ids.description: Additional stop tokens. Llama-3.2-1B IDs must be below 128256. Non-empty stop_token_ids cannot be combined with ignore_eos=true.

ignore_eos.description: Ignore model stop tokens and generate up to max_tokens. Cannot be combined with non-empty stop_token_ids because the engine disables all stop-token handling in this mode.

logprobs.description: Accepted for client compatibility; response logprobs are always null.

session_id.description: Supported only with a single prompt.

role.description: Message role: system, user, or assistant

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

stream.description: Whether to stream the response as SSE

enable_reasoning.description: When false, reasoning models (e.g. DeepSeek-R1) skip chain-of-thought and respond directly. Has no effect on non-reasoning models.

continuous_usage_stats.description: Include usage stats in each streamed chunk

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the completion

ttft_ms.description: Time to first token in milliseconds

model_ready.description: Whether the model is ready for inference

queue_size.description: Current number of requests in queue

worker_info.description: Worker status keyed by worker ID (Python-server-compatible format)

runner_in_use.description: Active runner identifier (image services only). Mirrors the Python ModelRunners enum (e.g. 'tt-sdxl-trace', 'tt-sdxl-image-to-image', 'tt-sdxl-edit'). Omitted when the active service does not expose a runner.

pid.description: Worker process ID (-1 for in-process runners)

version.description: Release version from the top-level VERSION file. "unknown" if the file was not found at build time.

commit.description: Full git SHA of the inference-server tree at build time. "unknown" if .git was not available.
Full git SHA of the dependency at build time. "unknown" if the dependency's working tree was not present.

max_session_count.description: New maximum session count. Set to 0 to clear override and use environment variable value.
The new maximum session count that was set

model.description: Model identifier to use for embedding

ImageGenerateRequest.description: Superset of fields for /v1/images/generations, /v1/images/image-to-image, and /v1/images/edits. The active route enforces its own subset (image-to-image requires `image`; edits also requires `mask`).

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired output image

prompt_2.description: Optional secondary prompt routed to the second text encoder (SDXL)

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt describing what to avoid

negative_prompt_2.description: Optional secondary negative prompt for the second text encoder

guidance_rescale.description: Guidance rescale factor (mitigates over-saturation at high guidance)

number_of_images.description: Number of images to generate per request

timesteps.description: Optional explicit list of timesteps for the scheduler

sigmas.description: Optional explicit list of sigmas for the scheduler

lora_path.description: Path to a LoRA weights file to load before generation

image_return_format.description: Encoding format for the returned base64 image bytes

image_quality.description: Quality factor for JPEG encoding (ignored for PNG). Bounds match the Python service's Pydantic constraint (ge=50, le=100).

image.description: Base64-encoded input image. Required for image-to-image and edits.

mask.description: Base64-encoded mask image. Required for edits/inpainting.

strength.description: Image-to-image strength (0..1); higher values diverge further from the input image.

items.description: Base64-encoded image bytes in the requested image_return_format

generation_time.description: Wall-clock generation time in seconds (omitted when zero)

VideoGenerateRequest.description: Text-to-video request. Limits that depend on the served model (frame counts, resolution) are checked by the runner.

prompt.description: Text prompt. Must not be empty or only spaces

seed.description: Random seed. The same seed gives the same video

aspect_ratio.description: For example `16:9`. Must not be empty

async.description: false = sync mode (see the `async` query parameter)

VideoRequestParameters.description: The parameters of the job as Python's model_dump shows them: every field is present and a field that was not sent is null (`num_inference_steps` shows the default, 20).

completed_at.description: Unix time in seconds. Present once the job is finished

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token authentication using OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. If not set, defaults to 'your-secret-key'.
